How much you can get

The amount depends on your adjusted family net income (AFNI), the number of children, and their ages.

On this page

  • Maximum amounts per child
  • How your income affects your payments
  • Calculation examples

Maximum amounts per child

If your adjusted family net income (AFNI) is under $34,863, you get the maximum amount for each child.

Maximum Canada Child Benefit amounts per child
Age of child Maximum annual benefit Maximum monthly benefit
Under 6 years of age $7,437 per year $619.75 per month
6 to 17 years of age $6,275 per year $522.92 per month

Effective date: 2024-07-01. Source: _data/programs/canada-child-benefit.json

How your income affects your payments

The payments gradually start decreasing when the AFNI is over $34,863. The reduction depends on your AFNI and on the number of children you have.

Income below $34,863

You receive the maximum amount for each child. No reduction is applied.

Income between $34,863 and $75,537

Your total payment is reduced based on the number of qualifying children:

Reduction rates for AFNI between $34,863 and $75,537
Number of children Reduction rate
1 7%
2 13.5%
3 19%
4+ or more 23%

Your reduction is calculated as: rate × (your AFNI − $34,863)

Income above $75,537

Your total payment is reduced further. The reduction has two parts: a base amount plus a percentage of income above $75,537.

Reduction rates for AFNI above $75,537
Number of children Base reduction Additional rate
1 $2,847 3.2%
2 $5,491 5.7%
3 $7,728 8%
4+ or more $9,355 9.5%

Your reduction is calculated as: base reduction + rate × (your AFNI − $75,537)

Calculation examples

Single parent, 1 child aged 3, income $30,000

Inputs:

  • Number of children: 1
  • Child 1 age: 3
  • Family net income: $30,000

Estimated annual benefit: $7,437.00

Income below 34,863, so the full 7,437/year applies.

Family, 2 children (ages 4 and 8), income $55,000

Inputs:

  • Number of children: 2
  • Child 1 age: 4
  • Child 2 age: 8
  • Family net income: $55,000

Estimated annual benefit: $10,993.50

Max = 7,437 + 6,275 = $13,712. Reduction: 13.5% × ($55,000 - 34,863) = $2,718.50. Annual: $10,993.50.
